notes.note: Reviewed own-property lookup compatibility repair after hosted SDK/Board/Basis/examples and iOS build failure on Object.hasOwn. Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor preserves the exact allowlisted own-key behavior using older standard-library support; inherited constructor/prototype keys remain excluded. No code/kind/retryability/schema change. Contract91 tests and all four affected consumer typecheck lanes pass. Existing public failure and resource-spend claims remain accurate; no prose change needed.
